focus_areas.area: WAF coverage for internet-facing ALBs and CloudFront
Managed rule groups for baseline web threat protection
Logging and redaction of sensitive request components
Rate-based protections and L7 abuse mitigation
Legacy WAF Classic inventory and migration plan

rule.title: Coverage is Critical for PCI DSS
rule.description: If there are internet-facing ALBs/CloudFront distributions without WAF, treat as Critical for in-scope public apps.
rule.action: Use alb-waf-associations.json and cloudfront-distributions.json to identify missing associations.

rule.title: Logging must be enabled
rule.description: WAFv2 Web ACLs should have logging enabled and configured appropriately.

rule.title: Count-only reduces prevention
rule.description: Count-only mode is acceptable for tuning, but production protection requires enforcement (Block/Challenge/Captcha).
rule.action: Identify key rules where Action/OverrideAction indicates Count-only.

rule.title: Managed rules baseline
rule.description: AWS Managed Rules (Common, SQLi, KnownBadInputs, IpReputation) are baseline controls for common web threats.
rule.action: Look for ManagedRuleGroupStatement in rules. Note missing baseline sets.

applicability_and_gating.principle: Do NOT treat absence of resources as a failure.

rule.title: Evidence quality gates
rule.condition: If waf-collection-status.json indicates any API collection failures for WAFv2, CloudFront, ELBv2, API Gateway, AppSync, or Cognito.
rule.instruction: Generate ONLY WAF-013 (Low) describing the collection gaps, and do NOT generate coverage/configuration findings that would rely on missing/failed evidence.

rule.title: ALB coverage only if ALBs exist
rule.condition: If alb-waf-associations.json is an empty array, there are NO internet-facing ALBs detected in-scope.
rule.instruction: In that case: DO NOT generate WAF-001.

rule.title: CloudFront coverage only if distributions exist
rule.condition: If cloudfront-distributions.json is an empty array, there are NO CloudFront distributions detected in-scope.
rule.instruction: In that case: DO NOT generate WAF-002.

rule.title: API entrypoints coverage only if APIs exist
rule.condition: If api-entrypoints-waf-associations.json indicates 0 API entrypoints in-scope.
rule.instruction: In that case: DO NOT generate WAF-014/WAF-015/WAF-016.

rule.title: Do not generate hypothetical findings
rule.condition: If there are no in-scope protected entry points (no ALBs and no CloudFront), many checklist items become N/A.
rule.instruction: In that case: it is acceptable to return 0 findings. Do NOT invent "future" findings.

rule.title: Collection errors are not configuration findings
rule.condition: If evidence contains API errors (e.g., error fields), do NOT claim a security control is missing.
rule.instruction: Either (a) skip the related checklist item or (b) generate a LOW-severity evidence-quality finding referencing the error exactly.

focus.check: Detect and report evidence collection failures (WAF-013 only)
Internet-facing ALBs with WAFv2WebACL missing or error
Regions and applications with inconsistent coverage
Distributions with WebACLId empty or null
API Gateway stages without associated WAF Web ACL
AppSync APIs without associated WAF Web ACL
Cognito User Pools without associated WAF Web ACL
Presence of legacy Web ACLs in use
